headline: China’s AI Chipmakers Report First Profits Amid Supply Chain Hurdles
summary: Several Chinese pure-play artificial intelligence chipmakers, including Moore Threads, MetaX, and Iluvatar CoreX, swung into profit in the third quarter, though supply chain hurdles and soaring memory costs cloud their growth.
why: Domestic GPU developers in China are attempting to capture market share left vacant by US export restrictions on Nvidia, serving as an indicator of semiconductor self-sufficiency.

impacts.name: Chinese Semiconductor Sector
impacts.why: Reaching profitability demonstrates commercial viability, but supply chain bottlenecks continue to pose risks.
